fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Runs it down for 20 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hunting Party
fusions.desc: Sends 4 hawks out in a spread, each dealing 7 damage. If any of them hits, every ally near you strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Mobbing Guard
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Hawk at Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded hawk flies with you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill it makes restores 5 health to you.
